== Description ==

[[Nathan Russell]] (left, black Star Wars T-shirt, glasses, khaki cargo shorts, playing), [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (standing mid, black zip hoodie, glasses, arms crossed), [[Mark Billings]] (right, long dark hair in a ponytail, glasses, colorful geometric patterned zip jacket, playing), [[Jarad Konsker]] (mid background, bright green tee, seated), and [[Randy Scott]] (right background, orange cap, black hoodie, seated) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
